name: Rubik's Irish Championship 2025

information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6OTAwMjEsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--c411f6f86bee015155c5df7a3cac70b4a25db3d4/Plain%20Banner%20(1).webp)

**Please Note:** As this is Ireland's National Championship, only competitors who represent Ireland will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete.

**Final Round Advancements:** For events with more than one round, the top 6 Irish competitors will be guaranteed to progress into the finals in addition to the top 10 remaining best competitors of any region. For 3x3 finals, the top 6 Irish competitors will be guaranteed to progress into the final in addition to the top 6 remaining best competitors of any region.

**Free T-Shirt:** All registered competitors will receive a free t-shirt. Please fill in your t-shirt size in the comment box when registering. More info [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksIrishChampionship2025#59073-t-shirts)

**Fewest Moves Challenge**: FMC will not be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at [Rubik's Irish Championship FMC 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksIrishChampionshipFMC2025) on 9th August instead.
